title: Chalky Gouache
description: Style d'illustration de livre pour enfants du milieu du siècle utilisant de la gouache numérique et des techniques de pinceau sec. Présente des blocs de couleurs mates et plates avec des bords irréguliers et des accents de crayons de couleur griffonnés, créant une perspective chaleureuse, aplatie et naïve.
prompt: Digital gouache and dry brush illustration, mid-century naive art style. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Render forms using flat, matte blocks of {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}} with ragged, visible bristle edges and organic, imperfect contours. Completely avoid strict black outlines or clean vector cuts. Instead, define silhouettes through contrasting adjacent color fields. Layer internal textures, patterns, and fine details using thin, scratchy, colored pencil or crayon-like strokes in {{accent_color}} over the opaque base layers. Lighting is entirely flat, diffuse, and ambient; eliminate all dramatic cast shadows, specular highlights, or gradient shading. Achieve spatial depth strictly through the orthographic overlapping of 2D shapes, creating a charmingly flattened, naive perspective. Apply a heavy, tactile cold-pressed paper grain and chalky scumbling across the entire composition to unify the elements. The overall atmosphere must feel warm, whimsical, and distinctly handcrafted, reminiscent of classic lithographic or painted storybooks. digital gouache, dry brush, naive art, children's book illustration, chalky texture, matte colors, scratchy details, flat perspective, overlapping shapes, hand-drawn, tactile paper grain, scumbling, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame
